evidence_boundary: This is a committed build/tool preflight contract, not a device simulation result. It preserves the prior recovery contract and report unchanged while explicitly correcting their unverified Xyce archive-hash transcription in the new build input. A passing report can establish only that a reproducible pure-source serial Xyce binary was built from the independently rehashed GPL source and that its scalar B-source self-test plus parser-only frozen IGZO candidate syntax check passed. The self-test is not an IGZO equation, device curve, physical parameter, experimental calibration, route comparison or circuit result. Proprietary binaries are excluded, and Xyce source/build evidence does not replace AIM-Spice Level 15 or HSPICE Level 61. M01 remains E0 until both formal device-only routes and an independent persisted-evidence check pass; P3, P5, C00, circuit, layout, PEX and HZO remain closed.
next_gate: After this preflight and its independent check pass, execute the frozen two-route device-only DC contract once; any route failure is retained and stops M01.
